{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–12 (2002–2007 PDF slips), including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]]. It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 12]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS12''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–12. [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates|Virtual Set 12]] (Martyrs & Magistrates) has official text as of 9 January 2007.<ref name="vc12">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf] (swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 24 October 2007). Current copy: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards12.pdf res.starwarsccg.org].</ref><ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref><ref name="vs12">[[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]]</ref> The pool includes [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] (between original Virtual Sets 11 and 12). [[Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost|Virtual Set 13]] has official text as of 22 July 2007; from 6 August 2007 the pool is [[Premiere - Original VS13]].<ref name="vc13">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards13.pdf VirtualCards13.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195541/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards13.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The Players Committee events of early and mid 2007 whose deck sheets survive (the [[2007 Match Play Championship]], regionals, state championships and nationals) were played between those two dates, so their decklists on this wiki are filed under this pool.
